entries.name: Memtest86+ (EFI)
entries.note: Bundled in ISO, reboot-into from Diagnostics

entries.name: Oberon governor / CU status check
entries.note: Reports governor, GPU clock cap, detected CUs; does not change them

entries.name: BIOS Recovery Kit (J4004 + CH347 guide)
entries.note: On-screen wiring table, 3.3V warning, flashrom external-programmer commands

entries.name: BC250 Control Center (movacx)
entries.note: Full desktop control center: dashboard, governor, SMU CPU tuning, CU 24-40 (live vs boot state), fans, memory, verified BIOS USB creation, FSR4 upscaling, Decky plugin. MIT. Nirvana OS integration candidate - see docs/TOOLING-SURVEY.md

entries.name: BC-250 CU Live Manager (WinnieLV)
entries.note: Terminal UI for live WGP/CU routing via UMR (24->40 CU at runtime, custom tables, boot-restore service) plus SMU CPU core unlock. License not stated in repo - reference/link only until clarified.

entries.name: bc250-40cu-unlock (duggasco)
entries.note: Kernel-patch CU unlock + per-WGP health test + selective CU masking (amdgpu.disable_cu). The test-and-mask pattern nirvana-config adopts for the silicon lottery. License not stated in repo - reference/link only.

entries.name: bc250_smu_oc (bc250-collective)
entries.note: CPU overclock via SMU (bc250-detect/bc250-apply) with systemd persistence. Advanced/warned option in nirvana-config CPU tuning.

note: Diagnostics and utility tools are bundled in the ISO (no download needed). This catalog exists so Fanalogy can announce/retire tools live, e.g. a new GPU stress build.
